description: This Java source file 'LayoutTransChanging.java' defines an Android Activity that demonstrates how to use LayoutTransition to animate layout changes, specifically adding, removing, and resizing views within a LinearLayout container. It includes an inner class 'ColoredView' which toggles size and background color on click.

classes.name: LayoutTransChanging
classes.description: Main activity class that manages layout transition animations for adding and removing views.

classes.name: LayoutTransChanging.ColoredView
classes.description: Custom view class that changes size and color on click, used as animated elements within the layout.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up buttons with click handlers for adding/removing views, and configures layout transition settings.

methods.name: <init>
methods.description: Constructor for the inner class ColoredView, sets background color, layout parameters, and click behavior.
